title: Language Model Clients Integration
summary: This module provides core interfaces and implementations for interacting with various Language Models (LMs), including external providers like OpenAI and Databricks, and local models. It handles LM requests, responses, caching, finetuning, and deployment.

nodes.label: Configure DSPy Caching
nodes.title: configure_cache
nodes.description: Sets up the global DSPy caching mechanism, allowing configuration of disk and memory caches, directory, size limits, and serialization restrictions.

nodes.label: Initialize/Retrieve DSPy Cache
nodes.title: _get_dspy_cache
nodes.description: Initializes or retrieves the DSPy cache instance, falling back to a memory-only cache if disk initialization fails.

nodes.label: Enable LiteLLM Debug Logging
nodes.title: enable_litellm_logging
nodes.description: Activates detailed debug logging for the LiteLLM integration, useful for troubleshooting LM interactions.

nodes.label: Disable LiteLLM Debug Logging
nodes.title: disable_litellm_logging
nodes.description: Deactivates detailed debug logging for the LiteLLM integration, reverting to error-only logging.

nodes.label: Define Base Language Model Interface
nodes.title: BaseLM
nodes.description: An abstract base class that defines the common interface for all Language Models in DSPy, including methods for synchronous and asynchronous calls, history management, and response processing.

nodes.label: Manage Databricks LM Operations
nodes.title: DatabricksProvider
nodes.description: Provides functionality for interacting with Databricks LMs, including finetuning models, deploying them as serving endpoints, and managing data uploads to Unity Catalog.

nodes.label: Track Databricks Training Jobs
nodes.title: TrainingJobDatabricks
nodes.description: Represents and tracks the status of a finetuning job initiated on the Databricks platform.

nodes.label: Perform Sync LiteLLM Completion
nodes.title: litellm_completion
nodes.description: Handles synchronous chat completion requests using LiteLLM, applying caching and retry logic.

nodes.label: Perform Async LiteLLM Completion
nodes.title: alitellm_completion
nodes.description: Handles asynchronous chat completion requests using LiteLLM, applying caching and retry logic.

nodes.label: Perform Sync LiteLLM Responses
nodes.title: litellm_responses_completion
nodes.description: Handles synchronous requests to LiteLLM's Responses API, converting DSPy requests and applying caching/retry logic.

nodes.label: Perform Async LiteLLM Responses
nodes.title: alitellm_responses_completion
nodes.description: Handles asynchronous requests to LiteLLM's Responses API, converting DSPy requests and applying caching/retry logic.

nodes.label: Perform Sync LiteLLM Text Completion
nodes.title: litellm_text_completion
nodes.description: Handles synchronous text completion requests via LiteLLM, formatting messages into a text prompt and applying caching/retry logic.

nodes.label: Perform Async LiteLLM Text Completion
nodes.title: alitellm_text_completion
nodes.description: Handles asynchronous text completion requests via LiteLLM, formatting messages into a text prompt and applying caching/retry logic.

nodes.label: Manage Local Model Serving/Finetuning
nodes.title: LocalProvider
nodes.description: Enables launching and managing local language models (e.g., via SGLang) and performing local finetuning of models.

nodes.label: Track OpenAI Training Jobs
nodes.title: TrainingJobOpenAI
nodes.description: Represents and manages the lifecycle of a finetuning job on the OpenAI platform, including cancellation and status checks.

nodes.label: Convert to OpenAI Responses Request
nodes.title: to_openai_responses_request
nodes.description: Transforms a normalized DSPy LM request into the specific format required by the OpenAI Responses API.

nodes.label: Convert OpenAI Completion to LMResponse
nodes.title: completion_to_lm_response
nodes.description: Parses an OpenAI chat or text completion response and converts it into a standardized DSPy LMResponse object.

nodes.label: Convert OpenAI Responses to LMResponse
nodes.title: responses_to_lm_response
nodes.description: Parses an OpenAI Responses API object, extracting various output items (messages, tool calls, reasoning) and converting them into a DSPy LMResponse.

nodes.label: Extract Cost from LM Response
nodes.title: cost_from_response
nodes.description: Retrieves the cost information associated with a language model response, if available.

nodes.label: Convert to OpenAI Text Request
nodes.title: to_openai_text_request
nodes.description: Transforms a normalized DSPy LM request into the specific format required by the OpenAI text completion API.

nodes.label: DSPy Caching System
nodes.title: DSPy Cache
nodes.description: The internal caching system used by DSPy to store and retrieve language model responses, improving efficiency and reducing API calls.

nodes.label: LiteLLM Library
nodes.title: LiteLLM
nodes.description: An external library used for abstracting interactions with various language model APIs, providing a unified interface for different providers.

nodes.label: Databricks API
nodes.title: Databricks API
nodes.description: The external API for Databricks services, used for managing models, finetuning jobs, and serving endpoints.

nodes.label: OpenAI API
nodes.title: OpenAI API
nodes.description: The external API for OpenAI services, used for language model completions, chat, and finetuning.

nodes.label: SGLang Local Server
nodes.title: SGLang Server
nodes.description: A local server for serving language models, launched and managed by DSPy for local model inference and development.

nodes.label: LM Request Data
nodes.title: LMRequest
nodes.description: A standardized data structure representing a request to a language model, containing prompt, messages, and configuration.

nodes.label: LM Response Data
nodes.title: LMResponse
nodes.description: A standardized data structure representing the response from a language model, containing outputs, usage information, and cache status.

groups.label: User Configuration
groups.title: User Configuration
groups.description: Functions for configuring global settings like caching and logging.

groups.label: LM Interaction & Providers
groups.title: LM Interaction & Providers
groups.description: Core components for interacting with various language models and managing different LM providers.

groups.label: Data Processing & Management
groups.title: Data Processing & Management
groups.description: Components responsible for data formatting, response parsing, and managing training jobs.

groups.label: Data Structures & External Systems
groups.title: Data Structures & External Systems
groups.description: Represents the key data structures and external systems that the module interacts with.
